products.name: DSLR Camera — Canon EOS 90D
products.summary: A 32.5MP APS-C DSLR with fast autofocus, a flip-out touchscreen and sharp 4K video.
products.description:
The Canon EOS 90D is a serious all-rounder for photographers who want DSLR handling without stepping into professional-body prices. Its 32.5-megapixel APS-C sensor captures the detail you need for large prints, tight crops and client work, while 10 frames per second keeps up with events, sports and children who never stand still.

The vari-angle touchscreen and Dual Pixel autofocus make it just as comfortable for video, vlogs and shooting from low or high angles. It is a dependable choice for wedding and event photographers, content creators and training students who need one camera that does everything well.

- 32.5MP APS-C sensor for detailed, print-ready images
- Up to 10 fps burst shooting for action and events
- Vari-angle touchscreen with Dual Pixel autofocus for easy video
- Uses the huge range of Canon EF and EF-S lenses
- Ask us which kit (body only or with lens) is available

products.name: Wireless Mouse
products.summary: A comfortable cordless mouse that frees up your desk and works with most laptops and PCs.
products.description:
A wireless mouse removes the cable clutter and lets you work from the couch, a meeting table or a cramped desk without a tangle. It connects through a small USB receiver or Bluetooth, depending on the model, and runs on batteries that typically last for months of normal use.

It is a small upgrade that makes a big difference for editing, spreadsheets, design and long study sessions, because a full-size mouse is far more precise and less tiring than a laptop trackpad.

- Cable-free movement and a tidy desk
- Works with Windows, macOS and most Linux systems
- Light and portable, easy to carry in a laptop bag
- Tell us if you want a Bluetooth or USB-receiver model

products.name: USB Keyboard
products.summary: A full-size wired keyboard that plugs in and works instantly, with no batteries or pairing.
products.description:
A USB keyboard is the most dependable way to type. There is nothing to pair or charge, and it responds the moment you plug it in. A full-size layout with a number pad makes it ideal for typing documents, data entry, accounting work and everyday office tasks.

It is also the practical replacement when a laptop keyboard has failed or spilled drinks have damaged a few keys, and it gives desktop computers a fresh, comfortable typing surface.

- Plug and play on Windows, macOS and Linux
- Full-size layout with number pad
- No batteries and no wireless interference
- A cost-effective fix for a damaged laptop keyboard

products.name: Photo Printer
products.summary: Print sharp, colour-rich photos at home or in your studio, without waiting for a lab.
products.description:
A dedicated photo printer turns your pictures into lasting prints with smooth gradients and accurate skin tones. For photographers, studios and small businesses it means same-day prints for clients, passport and ID photos, albums and framed gifts.

Photo printers use specialised inks and paper profiles, so colours look closer to what you saw on screen than they do on a standard office printer. We can advise on the right size and ink system for the volume you plan to print.

- Designed for photo quality, not just documents
- Suits studios, event photographers and home use
- Works best with matching photo paper, which we also stock
- Ask us about running costs per print before you choose

products.name: 32GB USB Flash Drive
products.summary: A pocket-sized 32GB drive for documents, presentations and everyday file transfers.
products.description:
A 32GB flash drive is the sensible size for carrying documents, school work, presentations, forms and a few hundred photos. It plugs into any computer with a USB port and needs no software or setup.

Keep one in your bag for printing at the office, sharing files with clients or making a quick backup of your most important folders.

- Plug and play on almost any computer
- Small enough for a keychain or pocket
- Great for documents, slides and photos
- Need more room for video? See our 64GB drive or external hard drives

products.name: Brand-New Laptop
products.summary: A brand-new laptop for study, business, design and editing, with free advice on the right spec.
products.description:
A new laptop gives you a fresh battery and a clean system, which means fewer surprises and a longer useful life than a worn second-hand machine. We help you choose by what you actually do: office work and browsing need very little, while photo editing, video editing and design need more memory, a faster processor and a good display.

Tell us your budget and your work and we will recommend a model that fits, rather than selling you power you will never use. Ask us about software setup so you can start working the day you collect it.

- Brand-new: fresh battery and clean system. Ask us about warranty terms
- Spec matched to your work: office, study, design or editing
- Ask about RAM and SSD storage, which matter most for speed
- Ask us about software setup

products.name: 64GB USB Flash Drive
products.summary: A roomy 64GB drive for large files, video clips and full-folder backups.
products.description:
With 64GB you can carry bigger projects: high-resolution photo shoots, short video clips, software installers and full backups of important folders. It is a popular choice with students, editors and professionals who move files between computers every day.

It works on any computer with a USB port, with nothing to install, and it is small enough to keep on a keyring.

- Twice the space of a 32GB drive
- Handy for project hand-overs and client files
- Plug and play, no software needed
- Keep important files backed up in more than one place

products.name: MicroSD Memory Card
products.summary: A MicroSD card for phones, action cameras, drones and tablets.
products.description:
MicroSD cards add storage to phones, tablets, dashcams, drones and action cameras. For video and burst photos, speed matters as much as size: a slow card can cause dropped frames or stopped recordings.

Tell us which device you are using and we will match the right capacity and speed class so recording stays smooth. We can also supply an SD adapter if you want to read the card on a laptop or camera.

- Fits phones, drones, action cameras and tablets
- Speed class matters for 4K video, so ask us first
- Tiny and easy to carry in a wallet or case
- Check your device for its maximum supported capacity

products.name: Inkjet Printer
products.summary: An inkjet printer for sharp colour documents, school work and everyday photos.
products.description:
Inkjet printers are the all-round choice for homes, schools and small offices. They print vivid colour, handle photos well and cost little to buy, which makes them ideal when you print in moderate volumes.

Many models also scan and copy. Refillable ink-tank versions bring running costs down sharply if you print often, and we can show you which suits your usage. We also stock matching ink for the major brands.

- Good colour for documents, graphics and photos
- Low purchase price and a small footprint
- Ink-tank models give a much lower cost per page
- Genuine ink and paper available in the shop

products.name: Laptop Battery
products.summary: A replacement laptop battery to restore the hours your machine used to run.
products.description:
Laptop batteries wear out with use, and after a few years many only last minutes off the charger. A replacement battery brings back your freedom to work anywhere without hunting for a socket, and costs far less than a new laptop.

Batteries are specific to the laptop model, so send us the model number (usually printed on the underside of the laptop) and we will confirm a compatible battery before you pay.

- Restores full mobile working time
- Must match your exact laptop model, so send us the model number
- Far cheaper than replacing the laptop
- Ask us about fitting it for you

products.name: Desktop Computer
products.summary: A desktop computer built for the office, the classroom or the editing studio.
products.description:
Desktops give you more performance for your money than laptops, along with easier upgrades and better cooling for long working hours. They are the right choice for offices, business centres, schools, cyber cafes and editing workstations that stay in one place.

We can recommend a configuration based on your work: a reliable office setup for documents and browsing, or a stronger machine with more memory and a fast SSD for design, photo and video editing.

- More power per naira than a comparable laptop
- Easy to upgrade memory, storage and more later
- Configured for office, study or creative work
- Ask about monitor, keyboard and mouse bundles

products.name: Laser Printer
products.summary: A fast laser printer for sharp black-and-white pages at a low cost per page.
products.description:
Laser printers are built for volume. They print quickly, produce crisp text and do not dry out when left unused, which makes them ideal for offices, schools, business centres and anyone who prints documents regularly.

Toner cartridges last far longer than ink, so the cost per page is low when you print a lot. We stock compatible toner and can help you choose between mono and colour laser models.

- Quick, sharp text for documents and forms
- Toner lasts far longer than ink cartridges
- Does not clog or dry out between jobs
- Toner available in the shop

products.name: NVMe SSD
products.summary: Swap in an NVMe SSD for dramatically faster start-up, loading and file transfers.
products.description:
An NVMe solid-state drive is one of the biggest speed upgrades available. Computers boot in seconds, programs open almost instantly, and large photo and video files load and save far faster than on an old hard drive.

Compatibility matters: your laptop or desktop must have an M.2 NVMe slot. Send us your computer model and we will confirm it before you buy, and ask us about installing the drive and moving your system across.

- Much faster than a traditional hard drive
- Ideal for editing, design and everyday speed
- Needs an M.2 NVMe slot, so confirm your model with us
- Ask about installation and data transfer

products.name: DDR4 RAM
products.summary: More DDR4 memory for smoother multitasking, editing and design work.
products.description:
If your computer slows down with many browser tabs, Photoshop, Premiere or several programs open at once, more RAM is often the simplest fix. Extra memory lets the system keep more work ready instead of constantly swapping to disk.

RAM must match your machine: laptops usually need SODIMM sticks, desktops use DIMM, and the speed and generation must be compatible. Send us your model and we will confirm the right module first.

- A quick, affordable performance boost
- Helps with editing, design and heavy multitasking
- Laptop (SODIMM) and desktop (DIMM) sizes differ, so ask us
- Ask us about installation

products.name: HDMI Cable
products.summary: A reliable HDMI cable to connect laptops, cameras, consoles and TVs to a screen.
products.description:
HDMI carries picture and sound over a single cable. Use it to project a laptop onto a TV or projector, connect a camera for a larger preview, or link a games console or decoder to a display.

Cable length and version matter for 4K and high refresh rates, so tell us what you are connecting and how far apart the devices are, and we will give you the right cable.

- Picture and sound through one cable
- Suits TVs, projectors, monitors and cameras
- Ask for a high-speed cable for 4K video
- Several lengths available

products.name: External Hard Drive
products.summary: Portable storage to back up photos, videos and documents safely.
products.description:
An external hard drive is the easiest way to protect work that matters. Photographers and video editors in particular need somewhere to store hundreds of gigabytes of raw files, and keeping a second copy of every project is what saves you when a laptop fails or is stolen.

Pick up a drive with enough room for your current work plus growth. It connects by USB, needs no installation and is compact enough to carry in a bag.

- Large capacity for photos, video and archives
- USB plug and play, nothing to install
- A second copy protects you from computer failure
- Handle with care and keep important files in two places

products.name: Laptop Charger
products.summary: A replacement charger so a dead adapter does not stop your work.
products.description:
Laptop chargers take a lot of wear, and frayed cables or failed adapters are among the most common reasons a laptop stops working. A correct replacement gets you running again immediately.

Chargers must match your laptop in voltage, power rating and plug size. Bring the old charger or send us your laptop model, and we will match it correctly, because a wrong adapter can damage the machine.

- Get a dead laptop working again
- Must match your model, so bring the old one or send the model number
- Avoids the risk of cheap, mismatched adapters
- Quick to confirm before you pay

products.name: USB Hub
products.summary: Turn one USB port into several, so everything stays connected.
products.description:
Modern laptops often have only a few ports. A USB hub lets you connect a mouse, keyboard, flash drive, external drive and printer at the same time without constantly unplugging things.

It is a small accessory that saves time every day for editors, students and office staff, and it fits easily in a laptop bag.

- Adds extra USB ports instantly
- Great for mouse, keyboard, drives and card readers
- Compact and portable
- Ask for a powered hub if you use several drives

products.name: Epson Printer Ink Bottles
products.summary: Genuine-fit ink bottles for Epson ink-tank printers, for vivid colour at a low cost per page.
products.description:
Epson ink-tank printers use refillable bottles instead of small cartridges, which dramatically lowers the cost of every printed page. Refilling is clean and simple when you use the correct bottle for your model.

Tell us your printer model and we will give you the matching colours. Using the right ink keeps prints sharp and protects the print head.

- Matched to Epson ink-tank printers
- Far cheaper per page than cartridges
- Black, cyan, magenta and yellow available, so ask for the colour you need
- Give us your printer model to confirm

products.name: Glossy Photo Paper
products.summary: Glossy photo paper for rich colour, deep blacks and a professional finish.
products.description:
Glossy paper gives photos punch: saturated colour, high contrast and the shine people expect from a lab print. It is the usual choice for portraits, event photos, posters and sample prints for clients.

It performs best with an inkjet printer set to the correct photo paper profile, and different weights are available, so tell us your printer and size before you buy.

- Vivid colour and a professional gloss finish
- Ideal for portraits, events and client samples
- Use with inkjet printers and the right paper setting
- Handle by the edges to avoid fingerprints

products.name: Ink Cartridge
products.summary: Printer ink cartridges for dependable colour and black printing.
products.description:
A fresh cartridge restores faded, streaky or blank prints. Cartridges are specific to each printer family, so the number printed on your old cartridge, or your printer model, is what we use to match the right one.

We can help you choose between black and colour cartridges and tell you which options are available for your printer.

- Restores sharp, even prints
- Matched by printer model or cartridge number
- Black and colour options
- Ask about high-yield versions if you print a lot

products.name: Heat Press Machine
products.summary: Press designs onto T-shirts, mugs and caps for a custom printing business.
products.description:
A heat press transfers printed designs onto fabric and other surfaces using controlled heat and pressure. It is the core tool for custom T-shirts, caps, tote bags and branded gifts, and it is a practical way to start a small printing business.

Machines differ in plate size and shape: flat presses suit shirts, while mug and cap presses handle round or curved items. Tell us what you want to produce and we will recommend the right one, along with transfer paper and consumables.

- Start a custom T-shirt and gift business
- Choose a plate size to match what you print
- Needs transfer paper and a printer, both of which we can supply
- Ask us for guidance on temperature and timing

products.name: Toner Cartridge
products.summary: Toner for laser printers, giving crisp, smudge-free pages for thousands of prints.
products.description:
Toner is the powder that laser printers fuse onto the page, and one cartridge usually prints thousands of pages. That is why laser printing works out cheaper for busy offices and business centres.

Cartridges are specific to the printer, so give us your printer model or the toner code and we will confirm the correct one. We can also advise on mono versus colour sets.

- Crisp, dark text that does not smudge
- Prints thousands of pages per cartridge
- Matched to your printer model
- Keep spare toner so jobs never stop

products.name: ID Card Printer
products.summary: Print professional PVC ID cards for schools, offices, events and businesses.
products.description:
An ID card printer lets an organisation produce durable photo ID cards in-house, on demand. It suits schools, companies, churches, clubs and event organisers who issue staff, student or membership cards.

Cards are printed directly onto PVC for a clean, lasting finish. You will also need blank cards and ribbons, which we supply, and ask us about card design software for your logo and photo layout.

- In-house photo ID cards printed in minutes
- Durable PVC cards for staff, students and members
- Blank cards and ribbons available from us
- Ask us about card design software

products.name: A3 Photo Paper
products.summary: A3 photo paper for posters, large portraits and exhibition prints.
products.description:
A3 paper is large enough to give pictures real presence on a wall: wedding portraits, event posters, art prints and studio displays. The extra size shows off detail and makes a stronger impression than standard 4x6 prints.

You need a printer that supports A3, so check with us if you are unsure. We stock A3 printers and can match the paper to the machine.

- Wall-size prints for portraits and posters
- Needs an A3-capable printer
- Glossy and other finishes may be available, so ask
- Great for studio displays and client gifts

products.name: Mirrorless Camera
products.summary: A compact mirrorless camera with fast autofocus, great for both photos and video.
products.description:
Mirrorless cameras do away with the bulky mirror box, so they are smaller and lighter than a DSLR while delivering excellent image quality. Fast, accurate autofocus and an electronic viewfinder that shows your exposure before you shoot make getting the picture easier.

They are a favourite with content creators, wedding and event photographers and anyone who shoots video as well as stills. Tell us your budget and what you shoot, and we will point you to a body and lens that suits you.

- Smaller and lighter than a comparable DSLR
- Quick autofocus and a live preview of your exposure
- Strong video features for creators
- Interchangeable lenses let the system grow with you

products.name: HP Printer Ink Bottles
products.summary: Ink bottles for HP ink-tank printers, for steady colour at a low cost per page.
products.description:
HP ink-tank printers are refilled from bottles instead of cartridges, which cuts the cost of printing significantly for schools, offices and home businesses that print a lot.

Tell us your printer model and we will match the correct bottles. Using the right ink keeps colour consistent and protects the print head.

- Matched to HP ink-tank printers
- Lower cost per page than cartridges
- Black and colour bottles available
- Give us your printer model to confirm

products.name: Laminating Machine
products.summary: Protect certificates, ID cards and documents with a clean, durable laminate.
products.description:
A laminating machine seals paper between layers of plastic film, protecting it from water, tearing and daily handling. It is a staple for business centres, schools, offices and print shops that protect certificates, notices, menus and ID cards.

We can advise on the machine size you need, from A4 to A3, and supply laminating pouches in the sizes you use most.

- Protects documents from water, creases and wear
- A4 and larger sizes, so tell us what you laminate
- Pouches and film available
- Adds a polished finish to menus, notices and certificates

products.name: Canon Printer Ink Bottles
products.summary: Ink bottles for Canon ink-tank printers, for reliable colour at a low cost per page.
products.description:
Canon refillable ink-tank printers use bottles instead of cartridges, which keeps running costs low when you print often. Refills are simple when you use the correct bottle for your model.

Share your printer model and we will match the right colours. Correct ink keeps prints sharp and helps your printer last.

- Matched to Canon ink-tank printers
- Much cheaper per page than cartridges
- Black and colour bottles available
- Give us your printer model to confirm

products.name: Portrait Camera Lens
products.summary: A portrait lens that blurs the background and makes your subject stand out.
products.description:
A portrait lens with a wide aperture creates the soft, blurred background that gives professional portraits their depth. It also lets in more light, so you can shoot indoors and in the evening without raising the ISO too far.

Lenses are made for specific camera mounts, so tell us which camera you use and we will confirm compatibility before you buy.

- Smooth background blur for flattering portraits
- Wide aperture for low-light shooting
- Sharper than most standard kit lenses
- Must match your camera mount, so ask us first

products.name: A3 Printer
products.summary: Print large A3 posters, designs and photos in-house.
products.description:
An A3 printer handles twice the page size of a standard A4 machine, giving you the space for posters, flyers, menus, architectural drawings and large photo prints. It is a strong addition for print shops, studios, schools and design businesses.

We can recommend a model by your volume and the kind of work you print, and stock the ink and paper to go with it.

- A3 posters, flyers and large photo prints
- Useful for studios, print shops and design offices
- Ink and A3 paper available in the shop
- Ask us about running costs before you choose

products.name: Camera Battery
products.summary: A spare camera battery so you never miss a shot at an event.
products.description:
Batteries are the most common reason a shoot ends early. A fully charged spare means you can keep photographing through a long wedding, event or outdoor session without waiting for a recharge.

Each battery is made for specific camera models. Tell us your camera and we will confirm the correct one.

- Keep shooting through long events
- Must match your exact camera model
- A second battery is cheap insurance
- Pair it with a spare charger for travel

products.name: A4 Photocopy Paper
products.summary: Clean, bright A4 paper for printing and photocopying every day.
products.description:
A4 is the standard size for documents, letters, forms and school work. Good quality paper feeds smoothly, prints crisply and reduces the paper jams that slow down busy offices and business centres.

Buy by the ream or in boxes for offices, schools and print shops, and ask us about quantity pricing.

- Smooth feeding for printers and copiers
- Bright white for sharp text
- Suits inkjet and laser printers
- Ask about boxes for bulk buying

products.name: 4×6 Photo Paper
products.summary: 4x6 photo paper for quick, affordable prints of everyday memories.
products.description:
4x6 inches is the classic photo print size, perfect for albums, frames and handing prints to clients on the day. It is the usual choice for studios and photographers offering quick prints.

Use it with a photo printer or an inkjet printer set to the right paper type for the best colour. Ask us for the finish you prefer.

- The classic size for albums and frames
- Great for same-day client prints
- Use the correct photo paper setting
- Glossy and other finishes available, so ask us

products.name: Camera Battery Charger
products.summary: A dedicated charger for your camera batteries, at home or on the road.
products.description:
A separate battery charger lets you charge a spare while the other battery is in use, and keeps your camera free for shooting. It is a useful backup if the in-camera charger or cable fails.

Chargers are model-specific, so tell us your camera and battery type and we will confirm the correct one.

- Charge spare batteries outside the camera
- Handy backup if your original charger fails
- Must match your battery type
- Great alongside a spare battery

products.name: Camera Tripod
products.summary: A sturdy tripod for sharp photos, long exposures and steady video.
products.description:
A tripod removes camera shake, which is the most common cause of soft photos in low light. It is essential for long exposures, product photography, group portraits, timelapse and any shot where you need the framing to stay exactly the same.

Choose one that can carry the weight of your camera and lens with ease, and ask us about lightweight models if you travel often.

- Sharper photos in low light and long exposures
- Keeps framing consistent for product and group shots
- Adjustable height and fold-down for travel
- Check the weight it can carry against your camera and lens

products.name: Speedlight Flash
products.summary: An external flash for brighter, softer and more professional light than the built-in flash.
products.description:
An external speedlight is far more powerful than the pop-up flash on a camera, and because it can tilt and swivel you can bounce light off a wall or ceiling for a soft, natural look. It is a must-have for wedding and event photographers shooting in dim halls.

Flashes work with specific camera systems, so tell us your camera and we will confirm compatibility.

- Much brighter than a built-in flash
- Bounce light for flattering, natural results
- Essential for events and indoor shooting
- Match it to your camera system

products.name: Photography Softbox
products.summary: A softbox that turns harsh light into soft, flattering studio lighting.
products.description:
A softbox spreads light through a diffusing panel, wrapping it around your subject and reducing harsh shadows. It is the standard tool for portraits, product photography and video interviews.

It attaches to studio lights or speedlights and a light stand. Tell us what you shoot and we will recommend a size and the lights to pair with it.

- Soft, even light for portraits and products
- Reduces harsh shadows and glare
- Folds down for transport
- Pair with a light stand and a studio light

products.name: Portable Audio Recorder
products.summary: A portable recorder for clean, professional sound for video, interviews and music.
products.description:
Good audio matters as much as good pictures. A portable recorder captures clear, high-quality sound with far less noise than a camera microphone, which makes it a strong choice for interviews, short films, podcasts, music and events.

Record separately and sync in editing for the best result, or use it alongside your camera. We can advise on microphones and cables.

- Much cleaner sound than a camera microphone
- Ideal for interviews, podcasts and music
- Portable and battery powered
- Ask about microphone and cable options

products.name: Professional Video Camera
products.summary: A professional camcorder for long, reliable recording at weddings, events and productions.
products.description:
Professional video cameras are built for work that cannot be repeated: weddings, church services, conferences and broadcasts. They offer comfortable handling for long shoots, powerful zoom lenses, proper audio inputs and dependable recording time.

If video is your business, this is the equipment that clients notice. Tell us your budget and the work you do, and we will recommend a suitable model.

- Built for long events and steady handheld shooting
- Strong zoom range and proper audio inputs
- Reliable for weddings, churches and conferences
- Ask us to match accessories like tripod and light

products.name: LED Ring Light
products.summary: A ring light for even, flattering light on your face, perfect for video and portraits.
products.description:
A ring light wraps even light around your face and gives eyes a bright catchlight. It is a favourite for content creators, makeup artists, online classes and quick portraits, and it is easy to set up on a stand.

Most models offer adjustable brightness and warmth so you can match the room. Ask us about size and whether it includes a stand and a phone holder.

- Even, flattering light on faces
- Adjustable brightness and colour temperature
- Great for content creation, tutorials and makeup
- Often includes a stand and phone holder, so ask us

products.name: HDMI Capture Card
products.summary: Bring your camera or console into your computer for live streaming and recording.
products.description:
An HDMI capture card sends the video from a camera, games console or another computer into your laptop. With it you can stream a live event to YouTube or Facebook, record a gameplay session or use your camera as a high-quality webcam.

It connects by USB and works with common streaming software. Tell us what you want to capture and we will confirm the right card and cables.

- Use a real camera as a webcam
- Stream events and church services live
- Record consoles and screens
- Needs an HDMI cable and suitable software

products.name: Video LED Panel Light
products.summary: A compact LED panel for steady, adjustable light in video, interviews and events.
products.description:
LED panels give continuous light you can see in real time, which makes them easier to work with than flash for video. Adjustable brightness and colour temperature mean you can match daylight or warm interior light.

They suit interviews, product videos, small studios and event coverage. They are light, run cool, and can be powered by batteries or mains, depending on the model.

- Continuous light for video and photos
- Adjustable brightness and colour temperature
- Runs cool and is easy to position
- Pair with a light stand

products.name: Professional Video Tripod
products.summary: A video tripod with a fluid head for smooth pans and tilts.
products.description:
A proper video tripod uses a fluid head that lets you pan and tilt smoothly without jerks, which is the difference between shaky amateur footage and a polished result. It is designed to carry heavier cameras and keep them steady on long takes.

It is a worthwhile investment for weddings, interviews, church services and any production where the camera needs to stay still or move gracefully.

- Smooth, controlled pans and tilts
- Stable support for heavier camcorders and cameras
- Quick to set up for long events
- Check the weight rating against your camera setup

products.name: Photography Light Stand
products.summary: A sturdy stand to hold your studio lights, flash or backdrop at the right height.
products.description:
A light stand lifts lights, softboxes and reflectors to the right position, and keeps them stable. It is a basic but essential part of any studio or portable lighting kit.

Choose a stand tall enough for your set-up and strong enough for the weight of your light and modifier.

- Holds lights, softboxes and flashes securely
- Adjustable height and a folding design
- Good for studio and location work
- Check its load rating against your equipment

products.name: Photography Background Stand
products.summary: A backdrop stand for professional portrait and product photography.
products.description:
A backdrop stand holds paper, fabric or vinyl backgrounds so you can create a clean, professional set anywhere. It is useful for ID and passport photos, portraits, product photography and video interviews.

The width and height adjust to the size of your backdrop. Ask us about backdrops and light stands to build a complete mini studio.

- Clean backgrounds for portraits and products
- Adjustable width and height
- Folds away for storage and travel
- Ask us for backdrops in the colours you need

products.name: Smartphone Gimbal
products.summary: A handheld gimbal that keeps phone video smooth, stable and professional.
products.description:
A smartphone gimbal uses motors to cancel the shake of your hands, so walking, turning and following a subject all look smooth. It is a big upgrade for vloggers, content creators, wedding and event videographers and anyone shooting with a phone.

Many models include subject tracking and creative shooting modes. Tell us your phone and we will confirm it fits.

- Much smoother phone video, even while moving
- Great for vlogs, events and social content
- Folds small and charges by USB
- Check it supports your phone size

products.name: USB Microphone
products.summary: A USB microphone for clear voice recording, calls, podcasts and voice-overs.
products.description:
A USB microphone is dramatically clearer than the built-in mic on a laptop or phone. It plugs directly into your computer without extra equipment, so it is the simplest way to improve online classes, meetings, podcasts, YouTube videos and voice-overs.

Position it close to your mouth, away from fans and noise, and use a pop filter if you can to soften harsh sounds.

- Plug and play, with no extra gear needed
- Much clearer than a laptop microphone
- Great for podcasts, teaching and voice-overs
- Ask us about stands and pop filters

products.name: Camera Gimbal Stabiliser
products.summary: A gimbal stabiliser for smooth, cinematic camera movement.
products.description:
A camera gimbal uses motors to keep your camera level and steady while you move, giving you the flowing, cinematic shots that handheld footage cannot match. It is popular for weddings, music videos, short films and event coverage.

Choose a gimbal rated for the weight of your camera and lens together. Tell us your set-up and we will confirm that the right model fits.

- Smooth, cinematic movement
